name: Example-based Synthesis of Three-dimensional Clouds from Photographs
definition: A method to synthesize a cloud volume V storing extinction coefficients σt such that its rendered image resembles an input photograph Iph, using an example volume database Vex created by fluid simulation.
summary: This method synthesizes 3D cloud volumes from photographs by optimizing density to match photographic statistics and structural patterns from a database of physically-based simulations, differing from purely procedural noise methods.
